analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – solves a common ergonomic problem (mouse strain) with a novel solution. Demand is likely present, but competition in wearable tech is high.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Shows some progress (core hardware, prototypes, production partnerships), but the timeline is somewhat long and lacks specific milestones beyond initial stages.
